decision_authority.policy: MRX continuous quality-gated publication and two-image article creative directive

title: Understanding Fair Valuation: Key Factors for Assessing Your Mineral Rights' Worth
findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is 2117487db0feeeb7cc017505997ae5b07f61f33afd6a75ad6ceac8f1f1029a35; all 6 declared sources passed live access review.

MRX claims remain bounded to its current methodology and FAQ; Texas production claims remain bounded to Railroad Commission reporting scope and limitations; commodity claims remain bounded to dated EIA oil and Texas natural-gas series.

The article uses no fabricated owners, buyers, contracts, deeds, prices, acreage, ownership decimals, tax results, offers, testimonials, success rates, or owner-specific title, legal, tax, accounting, appraisal, investment, or transaction conclusions.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, Published DCF Methodology (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX methodology describes a directional DCF range with dated inputs, assumptions, limitations, and sensitivity, and separates asset range from offer consideration and expected owner net.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the methodology only for the disclosed directional framework, input-status discipline, sensitivity review, and transaction separation; it does not value a specific interest, establish ownership, or recommend a transaction.

sources_inspected.label: Mineral Rights Xchange, Frequently Asked Questions (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The current MRX FAQ describes the review as educational, directional, and not certified, and states that a possible later MRX buyer relationship is disclosed when applicable.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the FAQ only for the professional boundary and potential economic-interest disclosure; it does not promise value, price, an offer, payment, or closing.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Oil and Gas Production Data (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission of Texas production page provides compilations and summaries of Texas production information as reported to the Commission by operators, along with production queries and datasets.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only for regulator-reported production context and available reporting surfaces; it does not treat those records as proof of owner-specific title, decimal, payment, reserves, or future production.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Production Data Query System FAQs (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission Production Data Query FAQ explains that Texas oil production is reported by lease, describes reporting lag and operator-submitted records, and distinguishes crude oil from condensate reporting.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the FAQ only to define reporting-level, timing, source, and product limitations during reconciliation; it does not infer an owner’s attributable volume or payment result.

sources_inspected.label: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Spot Prices for Crude Oil and Petroleum Products (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The U.S. Energy Information Administration publishes dated crude-oil and petroleum-product spot-price series with units, history, definitions, sources, and notes.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the series only as dated benchmark context and requires the product, date, unit, differential, and scenario role to remain stated; it does not convert a public benchmark into a property-specific realized or future price.

sources_inspected.label: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Texas Natural Gas Prices (accessed 2026-08-12)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The U.S. Energy Information Administration publishes dated Texas natural-gas price series with units, availability labels, history, definitions, sources, and notes.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the series only as dated market context and requires the relevant series, period, unit, and limitations to remain visible; it does not convert a statewide end-use price into a property-specific realized or future price.
